name: Mown bermuda lawn
where: Club lawn, every mown residential lawn down to the bank; the commonest ground cover on the lake

real.habit: fine flat leaves from creeping stolons, many blades lying over; mowing leaves cut, square tips on half the blades; runners visible at edges and thin spots

mesh.names: SM_Grass_Lawn_0..3 (0.5 m square tiles), SM_Grass_Lawn_Light (a third of the blades, for 8 to 20 m)
